_readme: Ratchet baseline recorded from origin/dev on 2026-10-06 (guideline audit, CLAUDE.md §3 'No shared FAQ templates').

nameSwappedQuestions (test/faqTemplate.test.ts): a FAQ question with the page's exam/country name and numbers masked, and the number of indexed exam/maker pages asking it. Target: at most 3 pages, with no entry here.
splicedValueAnswers (test/faqTemplate.test.ts): pages whose FAQ splices a capitalised data value into a sentence ('does not match White').
siteWideDuplicateQuestions (scripts/quality-gate.mjs): a rendered FAQPage question (numbers masked) asked on more than one indexed page, and on how many.
Counts may only fall. When a page is fixed the check fails until its entry is lowered or deleted. Never raise a value or add an entry to make a check pass.
